definitions.explanation: Following established rules or conventions; officially recognized.

examples.japanese: {正式|せいしき}な{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んだ。
{正式|せいしき}に{発表|はっぴょう}されるのを{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: I'm waiting for the official announcement.

examples.japanese: これは{正式|せいしき}な{名前|なまえ}ではない。
examples.english: This is not the official name.

notes:
{正式|せいしき} is a na-adjective meaning formal or official.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {正式|せいしき}に (formally, officially)
- Noun: {正式|せいしき}さ (formality)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正式|せいしき}な{契約|けいやく} (formal contract)
- {正式|せいしき}な{発表|はっぴょう} (official announcement)
- {正式|せいしき}な{名称|めいしょう} (official name)
- {正式|せいしき}に{決|き}まる (to be officially decided)
- {正式|せいしき}{会員|かいいん} (official member)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正式|せいしき}: formal, official (proper procedure)
- {公式|こうしき}: official, formal (publicly recognized)
- フォーマル: formal (borrowed from English, often for dress code)
